articles.title: Polish families in Spain navigate cultural identity across generations, study finds
articles.source: Phys.org - latest science and technology news stories
articles.summary: Emigration often means a profound life upheaval. What challenges do Polish families face after moving to Spain? A researcher from SWPS University, in collaboration with her doctoral supervisors and a researcher from the University of Almería, analyzed family dynamics between children and their parents and found that life in a foreign country is not free from intergenerational conflicts. Parents are committed to maintaining contact with their Polish roots, while young people strive to develop their autonomy, and properly nurturing biculturalism turns out to be crucial.

articles.title: Show HN: A canvas-based note taking and organizer app
articles.summary:
So I've been working on this app for a very long time now. Started off by wanting an app that separates long form notes from short form notes visually and keeps everything organized on a canvas.
The app features:
-Sticky notes for quick, small notes and A4 notes for long form documents
-A quick mode that uses local storage to quickly open the app and jot down a thought on the canvas
-A PDF export option that exports your notes into 3 custom designed PDF styles
-Visual hierarchy to replicate file structure instead of a linear fashion, where your files are notes, stacks are folders and labels are names for your folders
Would love to continue working on this app if you guys like the concept.

articles.title: A tiny universe in a bottle reveals clues to the origins of life
articles.summary: Researchers have created cosmic dust from scratch by recreating space-like conditions inside glass tubes. The dust contains complex carbon-rich molecules built from elements essential to life and produces infrared signals similar to real material found in space. By studying these laboratory samples, scientists can explore how organic chemistry unfolds around stars and how comets, asteroids and meteorites may have carried those ingredients to Earth.

articles.title: The mysterious hum heard around the world may finally have an explanation
articles.summary: The mysterious sound known as The Hum has been reported worldwide for decades, yet its source often remains impossible to find. Researchers tested whether people who hear it have exceptional low-frequency hearing or measurable sounds produced inside their ears, but neither explanation fit most participants. The strongest possibility is that many cases involve low-frequency tinnitus, even though the sound seems completely external.
